seed_provenance: Labels read on this full sheet. Crossings seeded from opposite numbered ticks and long-line contrast on the native engraving. Fit and withheld margin rules alternate. Six southern longitudes under the scale are omitted.
longitude_correction_basis: Working two-step adjustment of −69 and −147.18 arcseconds.
quality_note: On 54 withheld graticule coordinates the affine fit has 4.23 arcseconds RMS error. The largest residual is 18.33 arcseconds at the numbered 78 degrees 25 minutes north-margin rule.
crop_review_note: All four frame strips and corners were checked at scan resolution. The northern frame bows about 21 pixels from its corner chord. A three-pixel inward cut follows the inner rule across the sheet.
